{{Quote|He'll say anything to save his skin.|A pirate|<ref name="SC 106" />}}
During the [[New Republic Era]],<ref name="SC 106" /> a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SC 106 ST" /> '''pirate''' was a member of a [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]] led by [[Captain]] [[Brutus]].<ref name="SC 106" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the man attended the [[Trial of Silvo|trial]] of former Captain [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]. After the defendant began his [[Right of Last Appeal|last appeal]] by bringing up the [[pirate]]s' hunger for credits, the individual concluded that Silvo would say anything to save his skin. In the end, Silvo's skin was indeed saved, but only conditionally, as Brutus promised to proceed with the [[Death penalty|execution]] if [[At Attin]] were to prove worthless to him.<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender|male]] [[pirate]] was first heard in "[[Zero Friends Again]]," the sixth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 106" /> which aired on [[December 31]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
